autoRenew.title: Auto-renewing subscription.
autoRenew.body: Pro Monthly and Pro Yearly renew automatically until cancelled. Renewal is charged within 24h of the period's end.

disclosures.billing: You'll be charged the price shown on the purchase screen in your local currency, billed by Apple (or Google) to your Apple ID / Google Play account.
disclosures.cancel: Cancel any time in Settings → your name → Subscriptions (iOS) or the Google Play app (Android). Cancellation keeps your access until the end of the paid period.
